summary: St. Joe-Clearwater region lookout near Clarkia, Idaho: crow's nest in 1915, log cabin with pole tower by 1928, abandoned in the 1940s; now listed as tower gone.

facts.design: Crow's nest (1915), then a log cabin with a pole tower (by 1928)
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association's Idaho list says 'Tower Gone'; no source describes what remains at the site
facts.agency: PTPA (initials as listed on idahofirelookouts.com and firelookout.com; not expanded in those pages)

visit.trail_note: Listed as a hike-in site on idahofirelookouts.com; no trail described

events.note: Abandoned in the 1940s; sources give only the decade, no single year

evidence.supports: filed in the St. Joe - Clearwater region
1915 crow's nest, 1928 log cabin with pole tower, abandoned 1940s
evidence.quote: 1915: crows nest. 1928: log cabin, pole tower. Abandoned 1940s.

evidence.supports: about seven miles southeast of Clarkia, Shoshone County
Clarkia in the southwestern corner of Shoshone County
evidence.quote: Clarkia is a small unincorporated community in the southwestern corner of Shoshone County

corrections.why: The FFLA Idaho list records the structure as a tower, and both lookout pages describe a pole tower

notes_for_editor: Two lookout-history pages agree on 1915, 1928 and the 1940s; today's status rests only on the FFLA list ('Tower Gone'). No staffing history is documented (idahofirelookouts.com), so staffing is omitted. Elevation is unknown on both pages. FFLA longitude -115.12145 differs from the record's -116.12341 by a full degree; the FFLA value looks like a digit slip but this was not resolved and the record was not changed. firetower.org was unreachable (connection reset) when tried. Story body is about 125 words after the footnote lines are removed.
